t: How To Respond to a Good Performance Review | Indeed.com
s: June 24, 2022 - When you receive a positive performance review, it can be beneficial to thank your reviewer right away to highlight your gratitude. Whether the reviewer is your manager or your peer, thanking them for the review can always be a great idea, as expressing gratitude can show that you value their time and professional feedback. To thank your reviewer in your response, you might begin by writing something like, "thank you for the positive review" or "I am very grateful for your kind words."This is a simple way to show that you're thankful for the good feedback and for the time your reviewer spent evaluating your performance.Related: 100 Ways To Thank Someone For Their Time
